Based on the provided passages, the proper way to fertilize your grass is as follows:

1. Time your fertilization at the beginning of the growing season, which varies for different types of grasses. Warm season grasses should be fertilized when the grass turns green in the early spring, while cool season grasses should be fertilized in the fall. (Passage 1)
2. Choose a fertilizer that is appropriate for your specific type of grass and perform a pH soil test to determine the correct pH level for your fertilizer. (Passage 2)
3. Apply the remaining fertilizer in a perpendicular pattern, and check if the leaf blade bounces back up after stepping on the turf to ensure that your lawn is in good shape. If the leaf blade lies flat, you may have over-fertilized. (Passage 3)
